run_upload_diff: run the upload.py script to upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to a code review server
run_GuessVCS: run the GuessVCS function to auto-detect whether the current directory uses git, mercurial, or subversion
run_SplitPatch: run the SplitPatch function to split an svn diff output into separate patches per file
run_EncodeMultipartFormData: run the EncodeMultipartFormData function to encode form fields and files into multipart form data
run_RealMain: run the RealMain function to upload a diff to a code review server and return the issue and patchset ids
